status_rationale: Lean formalization is available and compiles; no theorem-strength critic exists yet, so no blocker-major repair was required. This artifact proposes a bounded set of meaningful behavior theorems and no proofs at this stage.

unit.scope_boundary: Only ToBoolean value-coercion behavior for ECMAScript language values, including the B.3.6.1 [[IsHTMLDDA]] replacement branch. No runtime/memory/host model state is in scope.

compliance_notes: No proofs are included in this stage.
No vacuous functional determinism claims are included (ToBoolean is a pure returning Bool in this mapping).
All theorem names are unit-specific and tied to namespace Spec2Lean.ECMAScript.ToBoolean.

theorem_obligations.precise_statement_in_words: For every Boolean value b, ToBoolean on the corresponding EcmaValue.boolean returns the same boolean bit value.
theorem_obligations.lean_statement_sketch: theorem toBoolean_boolean_identity (b : EcmaBoolean) : ToBoolean (EcmaValue.boolean b) = toBooleanBool b

theorem_obligations.intent: Undefined, Null, specific numeric literals, BigInt zero, and the empty string are false in ToBoolean.
theorem_obligations.precise_statement_in_words: ToBoolean returns false on all explicitly enumerated falsy values in the abstract algorithm.
theorem_obligations.lean_statement_sketch: theorem toBoolean_falsy_primitive_cases : ToBoolean EcmaValue.undefined = false ∧ ToBoolean EcmaValue.null = false ∧ ToBoolean (EcmaValue.number EcmaNumber.posZero) = false ∧ ToBoolean (EcmaValue.number EcmaNumber.negZero) = false ∧ ToBoolean (EcmaValue.number EcmaNumber.nan) = false ∧ ToBoolean (EcmaValue.bigInt 0) = false ∧ ToBoolean (EcmaValue.string "") = false
theorem_obligations.conclusion: The listed primitive falsy values evaluate to false.

theorem_obligations.intent: If the object argument has the [[IsHTMLDDA]] slot, ToBoolean returns false per the B.3.6.1 replacement.
theorem_obligations.precise_statement_in_words: For any object value o marked hasIsHTMLDDA, ToBoolean of EcmaValue.object o is false.
theorem_obligations.lean_statement_sketch: theorem toBoolean_object_isHTMLDDA_falsey_branch (o : EcmaObject) (h : o.hasIsHTMLDDA = true) : ToBoolean (EcmaValue.object o) = false

theorem_obligations.intent: All non-falsy and non-web-compat-object values are true by default.
theorem_obligations.precise_statement_in_words: ToBoolean returns true for Boolean true, nonzero Number, nonzero BigInt, non-empty String, symbols, and objects without [[IsHTMLDDA]].
theorem_obligations.lean_statement_sketch: theorem toBoolean_truthy_default_branch (o : EcmaObject) (h0 : o.hasIsHTMLDDA = false) : ToBoolean (EcmaValue.boolean EcmaBoolean.true) = true ∧ ToBoolean (EcmaValue.number (EcmaNumber.nonZero 1)) = true ∧ ToBoolean (EcmaValue.bigInt 1) = true ∧ ToBoolean (EcmaValue.string "x") = true ∧ ToBoolean (EcmaValue.symbol (EcmaSymbol.mk "sym")) = true ∧ ToBoolean (EcmaValue.object o) = true
theorem_obligations.conclusion: The listed non-falsy values evaluate to true, and objects are true when [[IsHTMLDDA]] is false.

theorem_obligations.intent: ToBoolean returns a Bool for every ECMAScript language value in this bounded unit.
theorem_obligations.precise_statement_in_words: For every EcmaValue, ToBoolean yields either true or false; no other result constructor exists.
theorem_obligations.lean_statement_sketch: theorem toBoolean_is_total_function (argument : EcmaValue) : ToBoolean argument = true ∨ ToBoolean argument = false
theorem_obligations.conclusion: ToBoolean argument = true ∨ ToBoolean argument = false
